Subject: Weekly checkpoint: TheraHealth evaluation & legal checklist

Team —

Thanks for taking time this week. Quick recap and owners so we keep the close on track. Attached I’ve included the latest MAP workbook (TheraHealth_MAP_v3.xlsx) and our proposed redlines (TheraHealth_MSA_redlines_v2.pdf). High-level:

- Evaluation ramp: PoC starts next Monday (4/5). We’ve scheduled a 2-week evaluation focusing on latency and throughput for the core inference path (use cases: triage summaries, clinical note embeddings).
- Legal: TheraHealth sent an initial list of redlines; our counsel suggested compromises on indemnity and data residency. See redlines PDF for inline comments.
- Procurement/vendor setup: TheraHealth procurement requested PO, W-9, and vendor onboarding questionnaire (security contact + SOC2 report).

Action items (owners + ETA):
1) Aditya: deliver test VM + shared eval prompts to TheraHealth by 4/4 EOD — owner: aditya_rao@redwood.ai — due 2027-04-04
2) Lauren: finalize counterproposal for MSA clauses 7.2 (indemnity) and 9.1 (data access) and route to Legal — owner: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai — due 2027-04-03
3) Sergio: provide vendor setup packet (W-9, PO template, invoice schedule) to procurement@therahealth.com — owner: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai — due 2027-04-02
4) Jessica / Procurement: confirm internal approvals required for a 60-day PoC and provide a single point of contact for vendor onboarding -> Ben Carter assigned — due 2027-04-04

Please review the attached and flag anything missing. If legal needs a separate thread for redline negotiations, say so and we’ll spin one up.

Thanks —
Sergio

Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Weekly checkpoint: TheraHealth evaluation & legal checklist

Sergio / Aditya —

I reviewed TheraHealth’s initial redlines and drafted a short counter approach. Notes:
- MSA clause 7.2 (Indemnity): they request unlimited indemnity for third-party claims related to clinical outcomes. We cannot accept open-ended clinical indemnity; propose: carve to exclude clinical decision-making, limit to direct breaches of Redwood’s obligations, and add mutual indemnity for IP claims.
- MSA clause 9.1 (Data access & retention): they want 30-day data purge on all logs. We can support a 30-day retention for tenant data and a 7-day KV cache purge by default; for audit logs we can provide redacted logs for up to 90 days under contract.
- Order form: I populated the draft order form (TheraHealth_OrderForm_draft.docx) with PoC quantities and an evaluation credit line to cover PoC fees. Need finance sign-off on pricing code RED-POC-01.

Proposed next steps (legal path):
A) Legal (Marissa) to review and sign off on the counter language for clauses 7.2 and 9.1 — owner: marissa_cole@redwood.ai — due 2027-04-04
B) Send counter redlines to Jessica with a short explanation of why we can’t accept broad clinical indemnity — owner: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai — due 2027-04-04
C) Finance to confirm PO/invoice cadence and finalize order form language — owner: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai -> coordinate with finance — due 2027-04-05

If Marissa sees any showstoppers, flag them and I’ll join the redline call.

Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Sr. Sales Counsel, Redwood Inference
